L4 estimand: average post-2025-03-20 dynamic effect of the PumpSwap regime on log(1 + Pump ecosystem daily USD volume), using the market_daily_panel. Although the estimated association is positive, the mandatory event-study diagnostic found pre-trend risk, so it does not cleanly identify a causal market effect. Stakeholder outcome: pending (not measured).
